{{Quote|Mon Calamari, Agamar and Bakura have all reported similar attacks.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Game" />}}
During the [[Dark Reaper crisis]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched an '''attack''' on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].

==The attack==
After the [[Conquest of Raxus Prime|recovery]] of the [[Force Harvester]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and a first [[Battle on Alaris|test]] on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] unleashed the device on other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] and Bakura.<ref name="Game" />
